name: Trampling Livestock
disable: DC 28 Religion check to exorcise the animals' spirits, or DC 26 Nature check or DC 24 Stabling-lore check to soothe them

items.name: Sudden Stampede
items.text:
Trigger The door to the stable opens

---
Effect The mammoth spirits activate in panic, materializing into physical forms as they stampede toward the door to escape. All creatures standing within 20 feet of the door take 4d10+26 force damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save save).

text: Several ghostly mammoths arise from the floorboards, pawing at the ground in terror before stampeding toward the door.
